name: SumIt
description: SumIt helps authorized family office users query their accounting data from Claude. Users can authenticate with SumIt, select an MCP-enabled organization, inspect ledgers, chart of accounts, tags, account codes, journal entries, account balances, balance sheets, and income summaries, and submit product feedback about the MCP connector. The connector uses the user's existing SumIt permissions and is designed for read-only accounting analysis, except for private session organization selection and internal feedback capture.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SumIt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SumIt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.getsumit.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SumIt MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SumIt lists 13 MCP tools, including get_account_balance, get_balance_sheet_summary, get_income_summary, get_transaction, list_account_codes, list_accounts, list_ledgers, list_organizations, list_tags, list_transactions, set_organization, and submit_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SumIt?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SumIt in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
SumIt requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SumIt is developed by SumIt Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
